summary: Created a 5-phase implementation plan for the write-time record-versioning PreToolUse hook. Phase 1 authors the hook (3 inherited contracts plus a fail-open declare -F staleness guard and the library's 5-step pipeline order), Phase 2 its fixture test plus the restored lint/hook scope-agreement case, Phase 3 the bare registration on BOTH settings surfaces plus manifest wiring, Phase 4 the taxonomy/library documentation truth-up, Phase 5 the redeploy, four live probes and the complete gate set. Planning measured the live baseline (3 pre-existing BLOCKING findings, all H1 titles under lua/neotex/plugins/tools/himalaya/docs/, and 809 ADVISORY), which both grounds the advisory-silent write-time posture empirically and gives the implementer a pre-change attribution baseline.
